title: should re-resolve relative time window and re-query panels on manual refresh
verifies: clicking the global refresh button on a fresh relative (15m) dashboard re-issues panel queries while the period label and URL stay at 15m

title: should advance window and update URL period when relative period changes
verifies: changing the global relative period from 15m to 6h re-queries panels and rewrites the URL to period=6h with a Past 6 Hours label

title: should re-query panels on auto-refresh interval tick for a relative range
verifies: the auto-refresh interval drives the same relative-refresh path and re-queries panels without changing the period URL param

title: should not spuriously refetch queries during a passive settle window
verifies: a settled relative dashboard with no user action fires zero new search queries, proving the span-comparison fix suppresses spurious refetch
